timer_plan.reset_conditions: None; phases wait indefinitely for their matching confirmation.

priorities: Only the confirmation for the pre-scan phase is accepted; all others are ignored.
Execute at most one phase transition per scan. Confirmations are level sampled, so a held confirmation may be accepted on a later scan.
finishedButton resets only COMPLETE. A bottle still detected can start another cycle on the following idle scan.
Only the output associated with the updated phase is TRUE. Loss of bottleSensor does not stop an active phase.
No safety-stop input is specified. Provide any risk-assessed emergency stop and protective interlocks independently; do not claim this sequence controller implements them.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample all six inputs once. No edge detectors are required: bottle detection and confirmations use sampled levels.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Evaluate exactly one transition from the pre-scan phase using the sampled inputs. Apply finishedButton only in COMPLETE. If phase is invalid, recover to IDLE with outputs off; do not start a cycle until a subsequent scan.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required, so there are no calls in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign every output once from the updated phase: Pump_Motor=(phase=1), Filling_Valve=(phase=2), Capping_Machine=(phase=3), Packing_Machine=(phase=4), Completion_Light=(phase=5). Transitions therefore affect outputs in the same scan.
